label: XPS 15 (9530)
description: 15.6-inch creator laptop with 13th-gen Core H and RTX 40 graphics, Thunderbolt 4 and Wi-Fi 6E; no RJ45.
notes: No wired NIC: Dell kept only Thunderbolt 4/USB-C on the 9530, so 1GbE arrives via a dock or dongle. Wi-Fi 6E (AX211) is standard; useful as a high-power host that is still wireless-only.
